actor_awards.notes: Best known for her role as Ma Kettle in the 'Ma and Pa Kettle' film series. She received an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress for her role as Ma Kettle in 'The Egg and I' (1947). Known for her distinctive raspy voice and tough, no-nonsense screen persona.

filmography.title: The Egg and I
filmography.role_description: The boisterous, overwhelmed, but loving matriarch of the hillbilly Kettle clan, a role that spawned a successful spin-off series.
filmography.plot: A newlywed city couple buys a ramshackle chicken farm and struggles to adapt to rural life and their eccentric neighbors.

filmography.title: Meet Me in St. Louis
filmography.role_description: The Smith family's outspoken and fiercely loyal cook/housekeeper who is treated like part of the family.
filmography.plot: In the year leading up to the 1904 St. Louis World's Fair, the four Smith daughters learn lessons of life and love.

filmography.title: Friendly Persuasion
filmography.role_description: A tough-talking, formidable widow who operates a farm with her three man-hungry daughters.
filmography.plot: A family of Quakers in Indiana face a moral crisis when the Civil War encroaches on their peaceful lives.
filmography.awards: Cannes Film Festival: Win – Palme d'Or

filmography.title: The Women
filmography.role_description: The tough, pragmatic woman who runs the Reno dude ranch where the society women go for their quickie divorces.
filmography.plot: A wealthy woman's marriage is threatened by a manipulative shopgirl, leading to a trip to Reno and a focus on the intricate social lives of women.

filmography.title: Dead End
filmography.role_description: The bitter, exhausted mother of gangster 'Baby Face' Martin (Humphrey Bogart), who famously rejects him upon his return.
filmography.plot: In a New York slum, the paths of a notorious gangster, a struggling architect, and a group of tough street kids intersect.

filmography.title: Stella Dallas
filmography.role_description: A harsh, judgmental woman who interacts with the tragic protagonist.
filmography.plot: A working-class woman marries a wealthy man but sacrifices her own happiness to ensure a better life for her daughter.

filmography.title: Heaven Can Wait
filmography.role_description: The domineering mother-in-law of the protagonist in this Ernst Lubitsch comedy.
filmography.plot: A deceased playboy tries to convince the Devil that he belongs in Hell by recounting his life of romantic indiscretions.

filmography.title: Ma and Pa Kettle
filmography.role_description: Ma Kettle must manage her chaotic brood of 15 children when her husband wins a modern, fully-automated dream house.
filmography.plot: The lazy Pa Kettle wins a modern, gadget-filled house in a slogan contest, forcing the rustic Kettle family to adapt to modern living.

filmography.title: A Woman's Face
filmography.role_description: The suspicious and harsh housekeeper who serves as a witness in the trial of the protagonist.
filmography.plot: A female blackmailer with a disfigured face undergoes plastic surgery, giving her a new lease on life but complicating her criminal past.

filmography.title: Dark Command
filmography.role_description: The mother of the film's villain, a conflicted woman dealing with her son's descent into evil.
filmography.plot: A Texan marshal battles a renegade guerrilla leader in Civil War-era Kansas.

filmography.title: The Harvey Girls
filmography.role_description: The tough but fair supervisor of the Harvey Girls waitresses in the Wild West.
filmography.plot: A group of mail-order waitresses head west to open a Harvey House restaurant and bring civilization to a rowdy town.

filmography.title: Test Pilot
filmography.role_description: A brief role as a landlady in this Clark Gable/Spencer Tracy aviation drama.
filmography.plot: A reckless test pilot and his long-suffering mechanic friend are joined by a farm girl who becomes the pilot's wife.

filmography.title: Another Thin Man
filmography.role_description: The quirky housekeeper/manager of a Long Island estate where a murder takes place.
filmography.plot: Nick and Nora Charles return to New York with their new baby and Asta, where they become involved in a murder case at a Long Island estate.

filmography.title: Summer Stock
filmography.role_description: The formidable housekeeper on the Falbury farm who disapproves of the actors taking over the barn.
filmography.plot: A farmer gets more than she bargained for when her actress sister arrives with a stock company to put on a show in the family barn.

filmography.title: Johnny Come Lately
filmography.role_description: The tough owner of a local mission/flophouse who helps the protagonist fight political corruption.
filmography.plot: A vagrant journalist helps an elderly newspaper editor fight local corruption in a small town.

filmography.title: The Wistful Widow of Wagon Gap
filmography.role_description: A fearsome widow who, by local law, inherits the man who killed her husband (Lou Costello), treating him as a slave.
filmography.plot: A traveling salesman accidentally kills a man in a duel and is forced by town law to support the dead man's demanding widow and children.

filmography.title: Ma and Pa Kettle Go to Town
filmography.role_description: Ma Kettle travels to New York City after winning a contest, getting mixed up with a bank robber.
filmography.plot: Ma and Pa Kettle win a trip to New York City and leave their 15 children with an unsuspecting friend.

filmography.title: Ma and Pa Kettle Back on the Farm
filmography.role_description: Ma Kettle deals with radioactive clothing and interference from her daughter-in-law's snobbish parents.
filmography.plot: The Kettles return to their old farm after their new modern house becomes too stressful, but complications follow them.

filmography.title: Ma and Pa Kettle at the Fair
filmography.role_description: Ma tries to win enough prize money at the county fair to send her daughter to college.
filmography.plot: The Kettles hope to win enough money at the county fair to send their oldest daughter to college.

filmography.title: Ma and Pa Kettle on Vacation
filmography.role_description: Ma and Pa get caught in an espionage plot while vacationing in Paris.
filmography.plot: The Kettles win a trip to Paris, where Pa inadvertently becomes involved with an international spy ring.

filmography.title: The Long, Long Trailer
filmography.role_description: A nosy trailer park neighbor who annoys the newlywed couple.
filmography.plot: A newlywed couple buys a large travel trailer to live in as they travel across the United States for their honeymoon, leading to disastrous comedic situations.

filmography.title: Rose Marie
filmography.role_description: A rugged hotel proprietor who acts as a maternal figure to the title character.
filmography.plot: A French-Canadian trapper protects a woman from the unwanted advances of a frontiersman.

filmography.title: I Can Get It for You Wholesale
filmography.role_description: A shrewd fashion designer who mentors the ambitious protagonist.
filmography.plot: An ambitious and ruthless woman claws her way to the top of the New York garment industry.

filmography.title: The Kettles in the Ozarks
filmography.role_description: Ma Kettle takes the kids to visit Pa's lazy brother in the Ozarks (without Percy Kilbride as Pa).
filmography.plot: Ma Kettle and the kids take a train trip to the Ozarks to visit Pa's brother, Sedge, and find him to be just as lazy as Pa.

filmography.title: The Kettles on Old MacDonald's Farm
filmography.role_description: Ma Kettle tries to turn an idle college student into a farmer in her final film appearance.
filmography.plot: Ma Kettle tries to help a city boy learn how to farm while dealing with a prize bull and romantic complications.
